subject: Re: CBD kickoff — fixing tail-class accuracy on long-tailed workloads
body:
Zofia,

Plan:

Staffing — Tereza 50% (reproduction: the two-stage config path, stage_one_vanilla then stage two, on ImageNet-LT via tfds-nightly since we added ImageNet-LT and iNaturalist18 to TFDS as part of the release); Linnea 40% (internal workload adaptation); Wanjiru 30% (data plumbing); Fumiko 30% from April (analysis + the go/no-go eval).

Compute — reproduction is moderate: ~64 A100s for the teacher ensembles, Titan best-effort should hold. SimCLR-style augmentation teachers double stage-one cost, budgeted for that.

Budget — flagging the Q3 continuation early: Idris verbally earmarked $180k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-28 for this project's scale-up runs, so we can commit to the larger teacher ensembles in the Q3 plan. Formal allocation lands when Q3 books open; cc'ing Idris so it's on the record.

Santiago
